name: @plusguard/scrollbar
description: A custom scrollbar from HTML attributes: a thin bar that shows on hover and while scrolling, and can be dragged or clicked — for the page and for any scrolling panel or pop-up, with or without Lenis. Zero dependencies, framework-agnostic. CSS included.

scripts.build: npx -p typescript tsc index.ts --outDir dist --declaration --target es2020 --module es2020 --lib dom,es2020 --strict

author: PlusGuard
